prompts.attack:

Preserve precisely the face, beard stubble, amber eyes, low dark ponytail, jade-petrol sleeveless split coat and pale wind motifs, ivory shirt with rolled sleeves, rust-red two-tail sash, three-rod bronze chime at belt, brown bracers and boots, charcoal trousers, dark scabbard at anatomical LEFT hip. Keep identical colors and clean linework/cel shading, SAME head size and lean long-legged proportions, no bigger torso or shorter legs. No re-design, no added armor.
Exactly ONE long thin silver slightly curved katana with bronze oval guard and cream hilt, conventionally held in anatomical RIGHT hand throughout; empty left hand. Right near shoulder is on image-left in reference. Never switch hands, mirror torso or turn back to camera. Keep shoulder/elbow/wrist connections readable. Blade exits thumb/index side of closed grip, pommel behind little finger, no reversed grips. Every frame full body and sword tip wholly inside its area. Camera fixed 3/4 toward screen-right. Sword length and accessories consistent across poses. Crouched poses are naturally SHORTER in total height, never enlarged to fill cell. Match source anatomical scale from one standing pose across whole sheet; head/limb sizes constant.
GENUINELY transparent alpha background, NO glow, no shadows or ground, no colored background, no trails/VFX, no text or grid. Separate all drawings by ample blank margins.
SIX attack drawings in landscape 3 columns x2 rows. This must be a full-body weight-driven katana CUT, not an arm extending while body stays idle. Use clean anime action keyposes with clear silhouette and moderate dynamic foreshortening. Leave large separation and sword margins within each cell.
1 Anticipation: weight shifts onto back/right leg, knees bend, pelvis rotates away from enemy, near RIGHT hand draws katana up-left beside shoulder, empty far left hand opens for balance. Both feet grounded.
2 Coil more deeply: chest twists left, near shoulder pulled back, front leg unweights ready to step, ponytail/sash lag. Right elbow bent, same sword pointing UP-LEFT. Same anatomical size; crouch is shorter than idle.
3 STRIKE: front/left foot steps decisively toward enemy SCREEN RIGHT, pelvis and sternum rotate forward, rear heel pushes, knees bent in strong wide lunge. Near RIGHT arm drives ACROSS FRONT OF TORSO at waist/chest level into broad horizontal sweep, sword extends RIGHT. Torso leans forward 20 degrees, not a static standing pose. Empty left arm visibly counterbalances behind; NEVER switch armed hand. Three-quarter front view, not back facing. Katana guard at thumb end not pommel.
4 Follow-through: transfer weight onto front leg, torso and shoulders rotate further with the horizontal cut, right sword hand continues right and down-right. Front knee bent and rear leg straighter, coat flares from waist rotation, ponytail sweeps behind. Distinct dynamic silhouette from frame3, no duplicated pose. Face stays visible facing enemy.
5 Recovery: pull weight back, step front foot toward home stance, torso straightens, right elbow relaxes, sword down-right. Cloth follows motion with overlap.
6 Near original idle stance with shoulders lowered and sword down-right. Keep head/limb scale consistent with all prior frames, identical clothing.
This is a lateral full-body slash with planted step, not a stab or overhead chop. Do not enlarge crouches. All pixels including sword tips inside each cell with blank separation. No trails, no flashes, no background. Preserve approved model exactly.
